title: WHO monographs on selected medicinal plants, Volume 1 — Radix Ginseng
locator: Radix Ginseng monograph: Definition p.168; Uses supported by clinical data p.172
scope_note: No single preparation, dose, route, or population is imposed in the Gold Case because the WHO monograph describes multiple dosage forms/contexts.
species_disambiguation_note: The WHO monograph explicitly distinguishes Panax ginseng from other Panax species and states documentation was insufficient to prepare monographs for those other species at that time.
